# Small random rater panels on DICES-350 (generated by scripts/dices_small_panels.py)

100 reshuffles of the 123 raters per panel size, each cut into disjoint panels. Inside each panel every method sees only that panel's raters. Accuracy (%) against the expert label on all 350 conversations unless a column says test half (176). **Natural**: each method's own rule (score > 0.5). **At FUSE est. / at DS-3 est.**: every method calls the same number of conversations unsafe, set by FUSE's or three-answer Dawid–Skene's estimated prevalence. Intervals: each conversation's hit rate averaged over all panels, paired bootstrap over conversations; they say whether a gap would hold on new conversations for this pool of 123 raters, not for new raters.

## All 123 raters (one panel)

| Method | Natural | At FUSE est. | At DS-3 est. | AUC |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Majority vote | 65.1 | 69.1 | 69.1 | 79.0 |
| Dawid–Skene, 3 answers | 68.9 | 68.6 | 69.1 | 78.7 |
| Dawid–Skene, Yes only | 68.6 | 68.6 | 69.1 | 79.1 |
| Dawid–Skene, Unsure as Yes | 68.3 | 68.6 | 69.7 | 78.7 |
| FUSE | 65.1 | 69.7 | 68.6 | 79.3 |

## Panels of about 5 raters (2400 panels)

Estimated unsafe share, mean over panels: FUSE 0.31, three-answer Dawid–Skene 0.31 (experts 0.50). FUSE fell back to a plain average in 0 panels. Best single rater in a panel (picked with the labels): 65.8.

| Method | Natural | At FUSE est. | At DS-3 est. | At FUSE est., test half | AUC | Called unsafe % (natural) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Majority vote | 63.1 | 64.9 | 64.9 | 65.2 | 71.7 | 26 |
| Dawid–Skene, 3 answers | 64.7 | 64.9 | 64.9 | 65.1 | 72.2 | 30 |
| Dawid–Skene, Yes only | 63.6 | 64.7 | 64.7 | 64.9 | 71.2 | 27 |
| Dawid–Skene, Unsure as Yes | 65.0 | 64.8 | 64.9 | 65.0 | 72.1 | 33 |
| FUSE | 63.4 | 64.9 | 65.0 | 65.1 | 72.3 | 26 |

| Comparison | Cut-off | Mean difference | A wins / tie / B wins (% of panels) | Over conversations (95% CI) |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, 3 answers | natural | -1.31 | 22 / 10 / 68 | [-1.89, -0.75] |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, 3 answers | natural, test half | -1.41 | 21 / 15 / 65 | [-2.26, -0.57] |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, 3 answers | at FUSE est. | +0.01 | 35 / 32 / 34 | [-0.07, +0.08] |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, 3 answers | at FUSE est., test half | -0.03 | 38 / 24 / 38 | [-0.14, +0.08] |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, 3 answers | at DS-3 est. | +0.02 | 34 / 34 / 32 | [-0.06, +0.09] |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, 3 answers | at DS-3 est., test half | +0.02 | 38 / 26 / 36 | [-0.09, +0.12] |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, Yes only | natural | -0.25 | 42 / 9 / 49 | [-0.48, -0.03] |
| FUSE − Majority vote | natural | +0.24 | 50 / 9 / 40 | [+0.03, +0.46] |
| FUSE − Majority vote | at FUSE est. | +0.04 | 41 / 21 / 38 | [-0.34, +0.42] |
| Dawid–Skene, 3 answers − Majority vote | at DS-3 est. | +0.05 | 41 / 20 / 39 | [-0.33, +0.43] |

| AUC comparison | Mean difference | A higher in % of panels | Middle 95% of panels |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, 3 answers | +0.07 | 55 | -1.5 to +1.7 |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, Yes only | +1.07 | 84 | -0.9 to +3.9 |
| FUSE − Dawid–Skene, Unsure as Yes | +0.25 | 61 | -1.6 to +2.3 |
| FUSE − Majority vote | +0.59 | 72 | -1.2 to +3.1 |

Majority vote's AUC with Unsure as 1/2 minus with Unsure as No: +1.17 (what Unsure is worth).

**Does the method find the good raters?** Spearman between estimated and true rater quality, mean over panels: FUSE +0.70, three-answer Dawid–Skene +0.71; FUSE's is higher in 31% of 2400 panels.
